items.title: Landed Cost Line Classification of Payables Invoices from File-Based Data Import
items.summary: The Payables Invoice Import spreadsheet gets a Landed Cost Enabled flag per invoice line. Lines set to Y go to Landed Cost Management for variance calculation and allocation. The column is hidden and blank by default, so existing imports are unchanged.

items.title: Legislative Updates for Fiscal Document Generation Layout supporting Brazil VAT Reform
items.summary: Stay compliant with the latest legislative changes impacting fiscal document layouts for Brazil VAT reform. Legislative updates are provided to address requirements introduced during government testing and the initial application phase of the new VAT rules.

items.title: Payroll Encumbrance and Liquidation
items.summary: The Payroll Encumbrance feature enables organizations to proactively reserve funds for estimated payroll expenses before payroll is processed. By recording anticipated payroll obligations in advance, organizations gain improved budget control, stronger financial visibility, and better alignment between workforce planning and financial management.

items.title: Account Alias for Joint Venture Accounts
items.summary: Joint Venture Management pages (partner contributions, source transactions, JV definitions, ownership assignment rules and overhead methods) now let you pick an account alias instead of typing every account segment.

items.title: Accounting for Multiple Partner Contributions in Stakeholder Billing
items.summary: When a stakeholder bill includes distributions funded by partner contributions with different accounts, Joint Venture Management now creates a separate accounting entry and invoice line for each partner contribution.

items.title: Automated Revenue Recognition for Sales Invoices with Prepayment Applications
items.summary: Sales invoices that include prepayment application lines can now have revenue schedules on their standard lines, using invoicing and revenue scheduling rules. The prepayment application lines themselves now default to the Immediate revenue scheduling rule.

items.title: Deep Links for Budget Entries and Budgetary Control Balances
items.summary: Use deep links to the Review Budget Entries and Review Budgetary Control Balances pages to access budgetary control inquiry pages directly from reports and dashboards.

items.title: Lease Payables Processing for Approved Payments
items.summary: Export only approved lease payments to Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables for payment processing. Lessees typically pay their lessors and other parties associated with their leases each period for rent, service, insurance, common area maintenance charges, or other amounts included in the leases.

items.title: Lease Transactions and Balances Report Improvements
items.summary: Use the Lease Transactions and Balances report to summarize the right-of-use asset and liability balances and changes. Lease administrators can now view the accounted right-of-use asset and liability balances and transaction activity in both the ledger currency and the entered currency.

items.title: Partner Contribution Invoice for Distribution Only Stakeholders
items.summary: Generate partner contribution invoices for stakeholders whose invoicing preference is set to "Create Invoices," regardless of whether "Distribution Only" is enabled for the stakeholders or the ownership definition.

items.module: U.S. Federal Treasury Reporting and Interfaces
items.title: Payment Justification and Program Record Inclusion in PAM Payment File
items.summary: Include the payment justification and program record in Payment Automation Manager, or PAM, payment files to comply with updated U.S. Department of the Treasury requirements.

items.title: Receivables Invoice Installment Creation Using a REST API
items.summary: Create Receivables invoice installments using the Receivables Invoices REST API. This feature enhances flexibility for users to automate the installment creation process, and adapt payment schedules to customer needs.

items.title: Service Excellence Continuing Investments
items.summary: A bundle of small usability, resiliency, performance and security fixes across Financials, for example an optional control that stops users deleting global intercompany invoices from the Payables Correct Import Errors spreadsheet. Check Oracle's page for the full list.

items.module: U.S. Federal Treasury Reporting and Interfaces
items.title: Supplier and Customer Default Trading Partner TAS Update
items.summary: Automatically update the Trading Partner Treasury Account Symbol, or Trading Partner TAS, on Supplier Sites and Customer Accounts when it reaches its expiration date.

items.module: U.S. Federal Treasury Reporting and Interfaces
items.title: System for Award Management Import for Customers
items.summary: U.S. federal agencies can now create customer records from imported System for Award Management (SAM) data, not just supplier records.

items.title: Virtual Card Reconciliation with Multiple Settlements
items.summary: Reconcile virtual card payments when suppliers process multiple settlements against a single virtual card. This feature ensures accurate reconciliation by matching all related transactions to the corresponding virtual card, and recording the card statement accurately.

items.module: Transactional Business Intelligence for Risk Management
items.title: New Advanced Access Requests Subject Area
items.summary: The new Risk Management Cloud - Advanced Access Request Real Time subject area provides built-in reporting and analytics for monitoring access-request activity, approvals, and associated risk.

items.title: Revenue Equipment Leases
items.summary: Create operating revenue lease contracts for equipment. Details of the lease include terms of the lease, asset details, parties, billing schedules, milestones, rights, and obligations.

items.title: E-Reporting for France
items.summary: Submit detailed Payables invoices and reports for French overseas territories (DROM-COM) electronically to the French tax authorities using designated service providers.

items.title: Japanese Corporate Tax Schedule 16 Reports Compliance
items.summary: The Japanese Corporate Tax Schedule 16 reports follow the National Tax Agency's updated templates: they can show global descriptive flexfields from Add Asset and Adjust Asset, use the revised era name and include asset category descriptions.

items.title: AI Agent: B2B Message Converter - Enrich Workflow Features Along with Upload and Download Capabilities
items.summary: You can use the B2B Message Converter AI agent to streamline the conversion of B2B messages such as shipments from a Fusion Application REST resource into industry-standard formats.

items.title: Additional Governance for Bank Account Transfers and Ad Hoc Payments
items.summary: Make use of additional governance for bank account transfer and ad hoc payment processes. Capture payment information during bank account transfers and ad hoc payments.

items.title: Cash Processing from Bank Statements and Remittance Advices
items.enablement: Off until set up (Service Request Required)
items.summary: Receipts can now be created automatically from bank statement lines, and remittance advices in several formats are read and matched to receipts in one flow. In 26B it's for early adopters only, enabled through a service request.

items.title: Data Extraction Using Read-Only Replicated Data
items.summary: Extract data with improved reliability and speed, with less impact on core application performance. The simplified extraction experience includes support for full or incremental extracts, on-demand runs or schedules, and status monitoring.

items.title: Embedded Receivables E-Invoice Integration with Thomson Reuters
items.summary: Use the integration with Thomson Reuters to send Receivables e-invoices to your customers. Receivables uses the Document IO agent to extract, transform, and deliver receivables transactions in electronic formats.

items.title: Ability to Enable Guided Journeys for Individual Sections in Activity Centers
items.summary: In My, Team and Person Activity Centers, the communications and guided journey banners are combined into one, and guided journeys can now be set up for individual sections (in Visual Builder Studio).

items.title: Approval Enforcement for Connections Photo Changes
items.summary: If you've set up a Change Photo approval rule, photo uploads, edits and deletes made from Connections now go through the same approval as Personal Details: the new photo shows as pending until it's approved.

items.title: Enhanced AI-Generated Comments for Redwood Employment Processes
items.summary: AI-generated assignment notes in Redwood employment processes get tone (Engaging or Formal), length (Summarize or Expand) and Rewrite controls.

items.title: Enhanced Guided Journey Parameters for Redwood Employment Processes
items.summary: Additional parameters are now passed to Guided Journey from Redwood Employment flows. This enhancement enables customers to configure Guided Journey tasks that leverage contextual employee and assignment data, such as navigating to external URLs with employee-specific parameters or generating customized BIP reports based on the current employee context.

items.title: New Redwood Process to Change Worker Type
items.summary: A new Redwood Change Worker Type process converts a worker from one type to another (for example contingent worker to employee) in a single guided flow, instead of terminating the work relationship and creating a new one.

items.title: Redwood Experience for Actions Reasons Page
items.summary: The Action Reasons setup page moves to Redwood: create and edit action reasons, translate text with the Translation Editor, and control the page with new Visual Builder Studio properties.

items.title: Redwood Experience for Assignment Statuses Page
items.summary: The Assignment Statuses setup page moves to Redwood: create assignment statuses and translate text with the Translation Editor.

items.title: Redwood Experience for Configure Actions Page
items.summary: The Configure Actions setup page moves to Redwood: create actions, link existing reasons, translate text with the Translation Editor, and use new Visual Builder Studio page properties.

items.title: Redwood Experience for Configure Seniority Dates Page
items.summary: The Configure Seniority Dates setup page moves to Redwood: create and edit seniority date rules, with new Visual Builder Studio properties to hide the Add and Delete buttons.

items.title: Update Checkin Page is Displayed From Talent View in Team Activity Center
items.summary: In the Talent view of Team Activity Center, the last check-in date now opens that check-in for updating, and if there's no check-in you can create one.

items.title: Monthly DSN
items.summary: French payroll can now produce the monthly DSN (Déclaration Sociale Nominative), the payroll report French employers must file every month. Setup is described in Oracle's France payroll technical brief (KB183664).

items.title: Payroll Encumbrance and Liquidation
items.summary: The Payroll Encumbrance feature enables organizations to proactively reserve funds for estimated payroll expenses before payroll is processed. By recording anticipated payroll obligations in advance, organizations gain improved budget control, stronger financial visibility, and better alignment between workforce planning and financial management.

items.title: Redwood Experience: Personal Payment Method Enhancements
items.summary: Employees and admins can now reorder personal payment methods that have different start dates, and employees can see payment methods that start in the future.

items.title: Statutory Neonatal Care Leave & Pay
items.summary: UK payroll now supports Statutory Neonatal Care leave and pay (legislation from April 2025): a new Neonatal Care absence type, accrual of up to 12 weeks' leave, and statutory payments for employees who qualify on average weekly earnings.

items.title: Tax Groups
items.summary: A new tax group level between the payroll statutory unit and its tax reporting units tracks state and federal limit taxes, so balances don't need transferring when an employee moves between TRUs that share wage and tax limits.

items.module: Transactional Business Intelligence for Health and Safety
items.title: New Metrics in Incidents Real Time Subject Area
items.summary: Augment your reporting on Environment Health and Safety - Incidents Real Time subject area with the new metrics. These metrics can be used across the health and safety domain of practice for internal reporting and regulator reporting purposes as well.

items.title: Change history turned off for creation record
items.summary: On the Redwood Absence Categories and Absence Reasons setup pages, Change Details now appears only for updated records, not newly created ones.

items.title: Default Workday Definitions from Work Patterns
items.summary: Absence Management and Time and Labor use workday definitions to derive the payment date for shifts that cross the day divide (usually midnight). You can now associate workday definitions with the worker’s work pattern instead of their primary assignment to better align their tasks with their user roles.

items.title: Display of Partial Day Absences on Worker's Calendar
items.summary: The Redwood Calendar now displays the absence duration in the event title for partial day absences. For elapsed schedules and absences with days UOM, the duration is shown in parentheses after the absence type name.

items.title: Event Processing for Front-loaded Accrual Plans
items.summary: Front-loaded accrual plans post an accrual only in the first accrual period of the plan year. But now, you can associate HCM Events with a front-loaded accrual plan to automatically recalculate accruals whenever there’s an HR assignment change.

items.title: New Return Variable for the Entitlement Formula
items.summary: The Global Absence Band Entitlement fast formula can be used to define the bands of entitlement duration and percentage of payment that are applicable to a qualification plan entitlement.

items.title: New Unpaid Break Display Field
items.summary: Redwood absence entry and calendar pages now show the unpaid break deducted from an absence. For example, a full 12-hour shift with a 30-minute unpaid break counts as 11.5 hours, and the break is shown.

items.title: HDL Support for Salary Basis Calculation Type Simple Component and Other Miscellaneous
items.summary: Salary basis records with the Simple Component calculation type can now be loaded with HCM Data Loader, and simple components work on Redwood offer pages and in Line Manager Change Salary and Salary History.

items.title: Hide or Show Component Columns in Salary Section of Recruiting pages
items.summary: You can now hide or show columns in the tables displayed in the Salary section of offer pages, when proposing salary with incremental, simple, or rates-based components.

items.title: Business Object Enhancements
items.summary: HCM Data Loader business objects gain new components and attributes, for example simple components on Salary Basis and an unpaid break duration on Absence Entry. Check Oracle's list against your HDL files.

items.title: Try the New Redwood Experience - Redwood for All
items.summary: Redwood is the future user interface for Oracle Transportation and Global Trade Management. The "Try the New Redwood Experience" for 26B provides all users with a view into the Redwood Experience for the areas of the application that have been migrated to the modern look and unified user interface provided by Redwood.

items.title: Try the New Redwood Experience - Redwood for All
items.summary: Redwood is the future user interface for Oracle Transportation and Global Trade Management. The "Try the New Redwood Experience" for 26B provides all users with a view into the Redwood Experience for the areas of the application that have been migrated to the modern look and unified user interface provided by Redwood.

items.title: AES Filing Enhancements
items.summary: AES filing follows the latest CBP export shipment (X12.601) changes: the SPP license exception for Syria (code C78, for EAR99 items) is added to GTM's default AES code mapping.

items.title: New Penalty Fields Available on Trade Program
items.summary: This update introduces new fields to the Trade Program to support identification of penalty-related programs. With this enhancement, Global Trade Management (GTM) can leverage the provided information on the trade program to split declaration lines by content type (e.g., steel, aluminum, or other materials) for customs reporting purposes.

items.title: Bulk Secondary Charge Shipments Creation Action
items.summary: This feature provides you with a Process Management action "Bulk Secondary Charge Shipments Creation" which allows you to create many secondary charge shipments at once.

items.title: Documents for Shipment Ship Unit
items.summary: Shipment Ship Units now support documents: add, upload, link, copy, generate and view documents, plus matching agent actions to automate document handling (for example packing lists and labels).

items.title: LNM - Updates on SCP - OTM/LNM Integration
items.summary: Changes to the Supply Chain Planning to OTM integration in Logistics Network Modeling: a new property caps the orders pulled per plan (default 10,000, with an error above it), only one SCP plan can be pulled at a time, and a running pull can be terminated and rerun.

items.title: Merge Shipments - Reuse Action
items.summary: This Merge Shipments - Reuse action provides the ability to merge shipments (and their related shipment equipment) for multi-leg shipment scenarios in cases where the involved itinerary has legs with the Equipment Assignment Type set to Re-use Equipment.

items.title: Mobile - Custom Sort-By Fields for Date and Number
items.summary: This feature enables sorting on attribute date and number fields. It is configurable so that you can add your required sort-by fields in addition to the default provided ones.

items.title: Mobile - Offline Feature Improvements
items.summary: This feature enables you to use the mobile app in Offline mode without needing to access the required screens at least once when online. You will only need to initially sign in to the mobile app and load the dashboard before using it completely offline.

items.title: Mobile - Planner Flow Dock Appointment Scheduling
items.summary: This feature enables the dock scheduling functionality for the Planner flow. You will now be able to view, add, modify, and delete dock appointments as a Planner user in the mobile app.

items.title: Move Order to Flexible Route Shipment
items.summary: This feature provides you with the option to use the Move Order action to move one or more orders into an existing shipment that uses a flexible route. This makes it easier to adjust shipments during planning without having to recreate shipments when routing needs change.

items.title: Override Calendar Action
items.summary: This feature provides you with an Override Calendar action, that allows you to select multiple calendars and then create calendar override(s) that will apply to the set of selected calendars.

items.title: TOI Extension – Invoice, Location Attributes, Local Dates
items.summary: This feature provides an extension to the Transportation Operational Intelligence (TOI) subject area. Analysis capabilities now include Invoice Consolidation Type and Invoice Type, Shipment and Order Release Location Attributes, and Date fields in local time.

items.title: Task Height Parameter for Gantts
items.summary: This feature provides you with a Gantt Parameter "Task Height" which you can use to adjust the height of the rows in your Work Assignment, Shipment and Dock Scheduling Gantts.

items.title: Additional Support for Purge Script Handling
items.summary: The WMS purge script now also deletes older history records, for example shipped serial number history after 3 years and pallet history after 6 months. Check any reports or integrations that rely on that history.

items.title: Cancel Carton Action to Support Cancelling Packed OBLPNs in Bulk
items.summary: The Cancel Cartons action on the OBLPN screen can now cancel picked and packed OBLPNs in bulk, not just those in Outbound Created status.

items.title: Display LPN Type Attachment in Inbound and Outbound Transaction
items.summary: A new LPN Type Attachments column on the Item Inventory by LPN screen shows how many attachments an LPN's type has, with a link to view them. It's hidden until you add it in grid settings.

items.title: Enhancements to Direct Allocation Mobile Transaction
items.summary: We’ve enhanced the Mobile Direct Allocation screen-flow to display order completion status and remaining quantities for each order. Introducing these indicators further empowers warehouse pickers by giving them clear visibility of order requirements and progress directly on their mobile devices, eliminating the need to access the UI and helping them efficiently manage their picking/packing process.

items.title: Expand Audit OBLPN to Handle Mixed UOMs
items.summary: The mobile Outbound Audit transaction can now audit OBLPNs that hold allocations in mixed units of measure (cases, packs and units). Before, those OBLPNs couldn't be audited.

items.title: Expand Picking using Pack NC Active to Handle Multiple Outbound LPNs
items.summary: We've expanded Pack NC Active (Non-Cubed Picking) to better support real-world warehouse workflows where pickers carry and build multiple outbound pallets/cartons (Outbound LPNs) at the same time.

items.title: Generate Cycle Count Info on Rejection of MHE Triggered Counts
items.summary: When you reject a cycle count that came from automated material handling equipment (MHE) through the Cycle Count List API, the recount task is now sent back to that MHE so it can do the recount.

items.title: Improvements to Alternate Location Determination During Picking
items.summary: The Ctrl-F Alternate Location option during picking now lists all eligible locations with available inventory, and keeps the allocation when no eligible alternate is available.

items.title: Improvements to Packing Tasks Calling Post Packing OBLPN Updates and Handling
items.summary: The Packing task flow has been enhanced to make the handoff into Post Packing OBLPN Updates and Handling more reliable and user-friendly by aligning the auto-scan behavior with the container-type configuration on the Post Packing screen.

items.title: Improvements to Predefined Integration for Direct Item Procurement
items.summary: In release 26B, we’re improving the prebuilt WMS–Inventory integration for Direct Item Procurement (DIP) to better control when inventory updates are sent to Fusion, and to enable scenarios such as host-driven putaway that were previously not supported.

items.title: AI Agent: Configuration Advisor
items.summary: Use an AI agent to help you identify the optimal configuration for a configured item according to your inputs. Use the agent to compare two or more configurations and select the best one.

items.title: Redwood: Add Ad Hoc Approvers on Purchasing Documents at Additional Positions
items.summary: In Redwood Purchasing, you can now add ad hoc approvers at more points in the approval hierarchy when submitting POs and agreements: at the start of the task, or the start or end of a stage.

items.title: Redwood: Add Lines from a Catalog to Purchase Orders and Agreements as a Buyer
items.summary: As a buyer, you can now directly add products or services from the catalog to purchase orders and purchase agreements using the Add from Catalog action. This makes it easier to add lines to a purchase order from an existing blanket purchase agreement and streamlines your ordering process.

items.title: Redwood: Award by Spreadsheet and Add Award Attachments
items.summary: You can now add award attachments to your negotiation from the Award Analysis Dashboard. You may attach supporting documents to justify your award decision or include them with the purchasing documentation.

items.title: Redwood: Collaborate with Catalog Administrators and Suppliers on Catalog Authoring
items.summary: Collaborate on catalog authoring using a Redwood page. You can transfer a draft blanket purchase agreement to the catalog administrator or supplier to collaborate in the purchase agreement creation.

items.title: Redwood: Create and Edit Purchase Orders with Supply Chain Financial Orchestration
items.summary: Create and edit purchase orders with supply chain financial orchestration using a Redwood page. The sold-to legal entity on the purchase order is now automatically derived from an eligible financial orchestration flow.

items.title: Redwood: Duplicate a Purchase Order or Its Lines When Editing the Purchase Order
items.summary: In Redwood Purchasing, you can duplicate a purchase order or its lines while editing it, and duplicate change order lines, including all their schedules and distributions.

items.title: Redwood: Edit Delivery Information on Multiple Purchase Order Schedules
items.summary: Select multiple schedules on the Purchase Orders page to edit delivery information for those schedules. You can update the delivery dates, requester, and deliver-to location details.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Purchase Agreements as a Catalog Administrator
items.summary: Manage purchase agreements from a Redwood page as a catalog administrator. You can now add content to agreements pending catalog authoring, and search and filter purchase agreements and lines using keywords and specific filters.

items.title: Redwood: Navigate to Source Agreements from a Purchase Order
items.summary: Use the source agreement link to drill down into backing blanket and contract purchase agreements when viewing purchase orders as a buyer or supplier. Before this update, the source agreement was just plain text.

items.title: Redwood: Process Credit Requisition Lines into Purchase Orders
items.summary: Process requisition lines with negative amounts into purchase orders using a Redwood page. Before this update, credit lines could only be added directly to the purchase order.

items.title: Redwood: Recalculate the Latest Purchase Order Prices from Blanket Agreement Lines
items.summary: Recalculate the latest purchase order price from the associated blanket purchase agreement line when editing the purchase order using a Redwood page as a requester, buyer, or supplier.

items.title: Redwood: Renegotiate Blanket Purchase Agreements
items.summary: Create negotiations from approved blanket purchase agreements using a Redwood page as a buyer. To start a negotiation, go to the Redwood Purchase Agreement pages and select the Create Negotiation option.

items.title: Redwood: Search When Editing Purchase Orders
items.summary: Search purchase order lines, schedules, and distributions when editing an initial purchase order or change order. You can use keyword search and filters to quickly find matching records on large documents.

items.title: Redwood: Support Business Rules for Business Classifications in Supplier Registration
items.summary: Visual Builder Studio business rules now cover the Business Classifications page of supplier registration, so you can make fields required, read-only or hidden by criteria such as country or industry.

items.title: Redwood: Upload Agreement Lines
items.summary: Upload lines to blanket purchase agreements from a Redwood page as a buyer, catalog administrator, or supplier. You can upload lines during agreement authoring and when creating an agreement change order.

items.title: Redwood: Use Additional Capabilities in Negotiations
items.summary: More Sourcing features in the Redwood pages: export and import requirements by spreadsheet for draft negotiations, view requirement details from scoring and analysis pages, response revision settings, and a minimum decrement per line in auctions.

items.title: Redwood: Use Extensibility Capabilities
items.summary: Redwood Purchasing extensibility now covers defaulting PO and agreement attributes with business rules, personalizing attachments and default attachment categories, project DFFs on distributions, and the View PDF action.

items.title: Redwood: View Budget Details with Funds Check Results
items.summary: The funds check result details have been updated to include a Budget view that displays control budget details, such as total budget, total consumed from the budget, budget balance, and other relevant information.

items.title: Redwood: View an Expired Status for Inactive Purchase Agreements
items.summary: Search and view purchase agreements that have passed their end date by using the expired status. Agreements with past end dates are now marked as expired.

items.title: Selected Procurement Contracts and Enterprise Contracts Bug Fixes in This Update
items.summary: Oracle's list of 26B Procurement Contracts and Enterprise Contracts fixes that change behavior. For example, purchasing documents for large contracts can now be created with a scheduled process instead of only in real time.

items.title: Selected Purchasing Bug Fixes in This Update
items.summary: Oracle's list of 26B Purchasing fixes that change behavior, for example document history is now shown for withdrawn and rejected POs on Redwood pages, and the expiring, overutilized and underutilized agreement filters no longer return draft agreements.

items.title: Use Supply Chain Orchestration to Support Contract Manufacturing for Process Manufacturing In Your Plan-to-Produce Flows
items.summary: Oracle Supply Chain Planning will send a planned order to Oracle Supply Chain Orchestration, then Supply Chain Orchestration will create a process work order to track the manufacturing progress at the contract manufacturers facility and a purchase order on the contract manufacturer to pay for the manufacturing services.

items.title: AI Agent: Configuration Advisor
items.summary: Use an AI agent to help you identify the optimal configuration for a configured item according to your inputs. Use the agent to compare two or more configurations and select the best one.

items.title: Add Approvers on Requisitions at Additional Positions During Shopping Checkout
items.summary: You can now add and manage ad hoc approvers at additional positions in the default approval hierarchy during shopping checkout in the Redwood Self Service Procurement application.

items.title: Labor Commitment Integration from Third-Party Payroll Sources
items.summary: Labor commitments can now be imported from a third-party payroll's encumbrance data and distributed to projects through the existing labor distribution flow, reserving budget for expected payroll costs and liquidating it as actuals post. Pay elements and labor schedules must be set up first.

items.title: Labor Costing by Project Role
items.summary: Cost project labor hours using project role-based rates. Labor costing by project role enables precise cost tracking and margin analysis by aligning actual labor costs with project roles used in planning and billing, resulting in improved accuracy and decision making.

items.title: Action History for Bill Transactions
items.summary: Review which actions have been performed on a bill transaction, when, by whom, and why. New user experiences provide a detailed, chronological audit trail of all actions associated with bill transactions, making it easier to understand why transactions are in their current state or why specific actions have failed.

items.title: Overridden Rate Retention During Financial Plan Rate Refresh
items.summary: Refresh cost, revenue, and burdened rates on financial project plans, budgets, and forecasts while preserving user-overridden rates at the periodic or line level.

items.title: Service Excellence Continuing Investments for Billing and Revenue Management
items.summary: For customers opted in to the Bill Transaction Creation on Cost Import feature, bill transactions are now automatically created for complex funding scenarios, such as when costs are funded by multiple contract lines or contracts.

items.title: Replacement Nomination Approval Workflow
items.summary: Allow project managers to approve or reject nominated replacement resources directly from actionable notifications. Resources and stakeholders are notified of assignment changes timely, increasing transparency and strengthening collaboration in the resource assignment process.

items.title: Award-Specific Viewer Access
items.summary: Assign view-only access to specific awards, rather than access to all awards within a business unit. For example, a user can have edit access to one award while having view-only access to another award.

items.title: Invoice Grouping Rules
items.summary: Define simple, reusable rules to group transactions into invoices based on combinations of common attributes, such as project and top task. Align billing to customer preferences by controlling how transactions consolidate into invoices.

items.title: Unprocessed Project Cost Exception Control for Predefined Sources
items.summary: Update or delete unprocessed project cost exceptions from predefined transaction sources, such as Oracle Fusion Payables and Oracle Fusion Time and Labor, directly in the Manage Unprocessed Costs page.

items.title: Calculate the Cost of Products After Assigning Phantom Subassembly Materials and Resources to Operations
items.summary: If you're a manufacturing enterprise and want granular control and auditability over the components consumed as part of the phantom subassembly in production process, you can now cost the materials and resources consumed in the phantom subassembly with the correct operation.

items.title: Calculate the Costs of Standard Costed Configured Items On Demand
items.summary: You can now calculate and publish the costs of all your configured items, even if those items don't have a new work order or purchase order in the application, if you use the standard cost method to value your inventory.

items.title: Redwood: Perform Lot Split, Merge, or Translate Transactions Using a Redwood Page
items.summary: Lot split, merge and translate transactions can now be done on a Redwood page, for example splitting off the damaged part of a lot under a new lot number, or merging several lots into one.

items.title: Redwood: Review and Select Lot and Serial Numbers from an ASN or Transfer Order during Receipt
items.summary: When you receive lot- or serial-controlled goods against an ASN or transfer order, you can now review and pick the specific lot and serial numbers you're receiving, instead of accepting every number on the document.

items.title: Redwood: Use the All Organizations Option When Selecting an Organization
items.summary: Many Inventory Management pages now offer an All organizations option in the organization chooser, so managers can see data across every organization they have access to.

items.title: Track Costs for Parallel Work Order Operations Using Precedence Constraints
items.summary: You can now plan for your product costs when your work definitions have parallel operations enabled. This allows for accurate calculation of your product costs, when using the standard cost method.

items.title: Redwood: Set Up Customer Pricing
items.summary: A new Redwood Customer Pricing page in Pricing Administration lets you set prices and pricing rules for a customer, account or group of customers, with effective dates. It's an opt-in in 26B and, per Oracle's opt-in expiration list, becomes standard (switched on) in 26D.

items.title: Selected Product Management Bug Fixes In This Update
items.summary: Oracle's list of 26B Product Lifecycle Management fixes that change behavior. For example, item revision attachments created or updated by import or REST now honor the needs-approval rule and create a change order.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Levels and Attributes Using a New User Experience
items.summary: A Redwood Levels and Attributes page for planning dimension hierarchies: rename levels for tables and graphs, choose which member identifier to show, add or delete item and organization attributes, and search by dimension, hierarchy and level.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Measures Using the Expression Builder and Measure Context
items.summary: With Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Planning, you can configure your own measures to analyze aggregated and disaggregated data for your environment. In this update, the Redwood user experience to manage measures has been enhanced so that you can quickly configure measure expressions and edit-lock expressions using an enhanced expression builder.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Levels and Attributes Using a New User Experience
items.summary: A Redwood Levels and Attributes page for planning dimension hierarchies: rename levels for tables and graphs, choose which member identifier to show, add or delete item and organization attributes, and search by dimension, hierarchy and level.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Measures Using the Expression Builder and Measure Context
items.summary: With Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Planning, you can configure your own measures to analyze aggregated and disaggregated data for your environment. In this update, the Redwood user experience to manage measures has been enhanced so that you can quickly configure measure expressions and edit-lock expressions using an enhanced expression builder.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Levels and Attributes Using a New User Experience
items.summary: A Redwood Levels and Attributes page for planning dimension hierarchies: rename levels for tables and graphs, choose which member identifier to show, add or delete item and organization attributes, and search by dimension, hierarchy and level.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Measures Using the Expression Builder and Measure Context
items.summary: With Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Planning, you can configure your own measures to analyze aggregated and disaggregated data for your environment. In this update, the Redwood user experience to manage measures has been enhanced so that you can quickly configure measure expressions and edit-lock expressions using an enhanced expression builder.

items.title: Redwood: Simulate Demand Using Additional Details
items.summary: Using the Simulate demand drawer from pivot tables in demand and demand and supply plans, you can select a forecasting profile; select output measures, forecasting methods, and levels; and run a simulation that produces decomposed results (totals and by forecasting methods).

items.title: Redwood: Execute Work Order Operations with Enhanced Options
items.summary: More options when executing work order operations on Redwood pages: inspect rejected quantities, see transactional item attributes, and upload attachments during execution. An opt-in in 26B that becomes standard in 26C.

items.title: Redwood: Pause and Resume Operations During Production Execution Without Workstations
items.summary: Operators can now start, pause (with a reason) and resume work order operations in flows without workstations, and run and stop times are tracked accurately. An opt-in in 26B that becomes standard in 26C.

items.title: AI Agent: Configuration Advisor
items.summary: Use an AI agent to help you identify the optimal configuration for a configured item according to your inputs. Use the agent to compare two or more configurations and select the best one.

items.title: Account for Component Scrap in Work Order Costs Without Material Returns
items.summary: You can now scrap an already issued component to a work order without having to do a component return. You can move the scrapped item to a specific subinventory where it can be reviewed before a final disposition.

items.title: Calculate and Track Product Costs when Using an Item Multiple Times in a Discrete Work Order Operation
items.summary: If you use an item multiple times in a discrete work order operation or in a flow schedule, you can now calculate your product costs and cost the transactions. Additionally, if you use standard cost, you can track variances by the item and basis type.

items.title: Complete the Same Output Across Multiple Operations in Discrete Manufacturing
items.summary: You can now add co-products and by-products to different operations in a discrete work definition or work order, with enhanced support for accurate cost calculations.

items.title: Derive Receivables and Payables Accounts for External Trade Events Using Transaction Account Definition
items.summary: Receivables and Payables accounts for external trade events in Supply Chain Financial Orchestration can now be derived with a Transaction Account Definition, not only from the control accounts on the financial agreement.

items.title: Enable Accurate Capture and Fiscal Processing for Prepayments Under the New Tax Regime
items.summary: In Brazil, a new Prepayment fiscal flow for purchase orders lets you record, tax and track supplier prepayments before goods arrive, and applies them to the final invoice.

items.title: Generate Intercompany Events for Oracle Transportation Management Interface for Customer Drop Shipments
items.summary: Supply Chain Financial Orchestration now publishes a Transfer Pricing business event for shipment-driven flows, including customer drop shipments, that other systems such as OTM and GTM can subscribe to.

items.title: Redwood: Export All Search Results on the Completed Transactions Page
items.summary: The Completed Transactions page has a new Export All button that downloads every search result, not just the rows on screen.

expiring.title: Lease Classification, Party, and Legal Entity Update in Expense Leases
Lease Payments in Arrears
Automatic Adjustment of Total Satisfaction Percentage in Revenue Management for a Contract Line Amount Amendment
Partial Amounts and Upper Limits in Netting Settlements
Change Order Automation for Financial Project Plan Amount Adjustments
Change Order Automation for Project Scope Adjustments
Redwood: View and Edit Asset Details
Enforce Integer Quantities for Materials in Work Orders and Production Transactions
Execute Production Without Defining Workstations
Enforce Integer Quantities for Materials in Orderless Transactions and Flow Schedule Execution
Redwood: Create Purchase Orders and Work Orders Using Supply Chain Orchestration

items.title: Invoice Import with Supplier Bank Account Details Using Collaboration Messaging Framework
items.summary: B2B XML invoices imported into Payables through Collaboration Messaging can now carry the supplier's remit-to bank account number and IBAN, and the invoice installment is paid to that account. If the bank details are left out, Payables falls back to the supplier's primary bank account.

items.title: Accrued Expense Migration for Exempt Payments
items.summary: Import midlife leases with exempt payments by capturing accrued expense migration balances and recognizing exempt payments as expenses evenly over the remaining lease term.

items.title: Active Ownership Definition Corrections
items.summary: Correct active ownership definitions and rebill affected joint venture transactions. This enhancement eliminates the need to end an active ownership definition and create a new one when ownership changes are required.

items.title: AutoApproved Multitier Intercompany Transaction
items.summary: Automatically create intercompany transactions, intercompany invoices, and accounting entries by enabling autoapproval of intercompany transactions. This feature streamlines intercompany processing while maintaining the flexibility to apply manual controls when required.

items.title: Budget Entry Creation from Revenue for Control Budget
items.summary: Assign a control budget when creating a budget from revenue using the Create Budget Entry from Revenue process. The assignment of a control budget aligns the expense budget scenario to a control budget when importing the budget into both Budgetary Control and General Ledger.

items.title: Calculation Calendar for Secondary Representation
items.summary: Generate lease amortization schedules and accounting entries for the secondary representation using a calculation calendar that is different from the primary representation.

items.title: Carried Interest Payout Processing
items.summary: Use carried interest payout processing to configure penalties associated with carried interest agreements. Track the costs, revenue, and balances being carried for non-consenting stakeholders; report on payout balances to the stakeholders; and close agreements after final payout.

items.title: Carrier Information in fiscal documents created from Receivables transactions
items.summary: Select a carrier for goods fiscal documents created from Receivables transaction and include the carrier’s address, taxpayer ID, and tax registration information in the fiscal document XML.

items.title: Cash Processing Agent for Receipt Processing and Cash Application
items.summary: An AI agent that flags receipt and cash application exceptions and suggests matches, building on Document IO's automated reading of bank files and emailed remittances. It's on by default, but users need the agent's security access before they can use it.

items.title: Consumption Allowance Revenue Recognition
items.summary: Revenue Management now handles allowance-based usage plans from Subscription Management (base allowance, top-ups, rollover and overage) and recognizes revenue for each part under ASC 606 and IFRS 15.

items.title: Lease Impairments by Representation
items.summary: Record lease impairments by capturing impairment percentages and recoverable values separately for primary and secondary representations. Lease administrators can create impairment transactions to write down the right-of-use asset balances for each representation, supporting compliance with varying regulatory or reporting requirements across different jurisdictions.

items.title: Lease Migration Balances by Representation
items.summary: Capture separate right-of-use asset and accumulated amortization balances for both primary and secondary representations when importing midlife expense leases. Record either gross or net right-of-use asset balances and their corresponding accumulated amortization for each representation during the migration of lease portfolios.

items.title: Original Invoice and Credit Memo References for Rebill Invoices
items.summary: Use the Rebill Source Transaction field in the Create or Edit Transaction page to associate a rebill invoice with its original invoice, improving traceability during rebill transactions.

items.title: Receivables Transaction Date as the Fiscal Document Date
items.summary: Use the Receivables transaction date as the fiscal document date when generating fiscal documents. This capability supports business scenarios that require issuing a fiscal document with a past date, such as recognizing ICMS tax credits for fixed assets or aligning transaction recognition with the appropriate fiscal document period.

items.title: Revenue Contract Realignment
items.summary: Reassign performance obligations between revenue contracts to correct any misidentified contract arrangements, ensuring that obligations originating from multiple orders are accurately consolidated into a single contract.

items.title: Service Excellence Continuing Investments
items.summary: A bundle of small usability, resiliency, performance and security fixes across Financials, for example a new Subledger Accounting source (Prepayment Line Type Code) for prepayment lines. Check Oracle's page for the full list.

items.title: Retirement Assistant
items.summary: Retirement Assistant is designed to simplify and streamline the asset retirement process through an intuitive conversational experience that helps fixed asset accountants submit, review, and process retirement activity more efficiently.

items.module: Transactional Business Intelligence for Risk Management
items.title: New Dashboard for Reviewing Intra-Role Violations
items.summary: A new dashboard for reviewing intra-role access violations: counts of affected roles and users, with drill-down to entitlements, incident paths and violations by algorithm.

items.module: Transactional Business Intelligence for Risk Management
items.title: New My Access Requests Dashboard
items.summary: Use a pre-built dashboard to monitor requesters’ access request activity and approvals based on the new Advanced Access Requests subject area introduced in 26B.

items.title: Additional Satisfaction Event Hold Release Using a REST API
items.summary: Use the Additional Satisfaction Events REST API to release revenue on performance obligations by recording the completion of customer acceptance, payments, or service provisioning events.

items.title: Attributes for Asset Addition Using ERP Integration REST API
items.summary: The addAsset service of the ERP Integration REST API now accepts impairment reserve and year-to-date impairment values when you add assets.

items.title: Automated Invoice Generation and Revenue Recognition for Equipment Leases
items.summary: Automatically generate periodic invoices and recognize revenue for equipment leases. Lease administrators can invoice lessees for rent, service, maintenance, and other charges defined in the lease.

items.title: Brazilian Fiscal Documents in Local Currency for Shipments of Sales Orders in Foreign Currency
items.summary: Generate and report fiscal documents in Brazilian Real for shipments associated with sales orders entered in foreign currency. The process automatically converts foreign currency amounts to the local currency and displays the converted values on the Fiscal Document page and in the XML sent to the tax authority.

items.title: Budget Adjustment Assistant
items.summary: An AI assistant that helps budget office users create budget entries in plain language for control budgets sourced from EPM, fix errors before submitting, and check budgetary control balances. Users need the Budget Adjustment Assistant role.

items.title: Cash Processing Agent for Cash Positioning and Improved Liquidity
items.summary: An AI agent that gives cash managers a conversational view of daily liquidity: cash position, bank balances, intraday movements and accounts short of cash. Users need security access set up first.

items.title: Display Page Properties Conditionally in Connections
items.summary: Admins can now apply Connections page properties, such as hiding the Feedback card, conditionally: by the viewer's role, whether they're viewing their own profile, or the profile's business unit, department, country, legal employer or location.

items.title: Redwood Enabled by Default for Employment Pages in Update 26D
items.summary: From 26D, the Redwood versions of the employment pages (Add Assignment, Add Contingent Worker, Add Nonworker, Add Pending Worker and more) are switched on by default through their profile options. Nothing changes in 26C, so plan your testing for 26D.

items.title: Redwood Enabled by Default for Employment Pages in Update 27A
items.summary: From 27A, the Redwood Resign from Employment, Terminate Employment and Mass Assignment Change pages are switched on by default. Nothing changes in 26C.

items.title: Redwood Enabled by Default for Person Pages in Update 26D
items.summary: The Redwood person pages (Personal Details, Contact Info, Identification Info, Family and Emergency Contacts and more) become the default in 26D, not 26C as Oracle first planned. You can switch back to the older pages by setting their profile options to No.

items.title: Assignment status change enhancements
items.summary: Learning specialists can now manage assignment status changes with more precise control. Some actions were already available in Redwood, and this release adds new restrictions and expands support for specific statuses.

items.title: Redwood Learning Catalog Management Enhancements
items.summary: These Redwood catalog management enhancements let you manage courses, offerings, events, self-paced learning, learning paths, catalog security, and catalog administration more efficiently.

items.title: Local Tax Jurisdiction Sync on Tax Withholding Card
items.summary: When a valid address is created or updated, the affected local tax jurisdictions now sync automatically to the employee's Tax Withholding card: Ohio and Kentucky school districts and Pennsylvania PSD and school districts (Indiana gets component creation only).

items.title: Redwood Experience for Payroll Setup Pages
items.summary: The Element Classifications, Consolidation Group and Payment Methods Preferences setup pages are now Redwood pages, with Oracle Search for HCM built in. They're on by default, and any personalizations of the old pages have to be redone.

items.title: Tax Calculation Statement Page
items.summary: This feature delivers a detailed online tax calculation statement for a specific employee and payroll run. Access the content using the new Tax Calculation Statement tab on the Person Results page.

items.title: Tax Credit Information Enhancements
items.summary: Enhancements were made to the Tax Credit Information pages to support additional fields for the federal and provincial forms. These enhancements impact both the employee self-service and the professional Tax Credit Information pages.

items.title: Compensatory Time Interface Enhancements
items.summary: If you use the Entry Level Approval timecard task, compensatory time earned now goes to Absence Management as each time entry is approved, so the balance is usable straight away, not after the whole timecard is approved. Compensatory time also now works for customers using only Projects with a third-party payroll.

items.title: Additional Extensibility for Redwood Add Absence
items.summary: You can now use Visual Builder studios to further extend the Redwood absence entry page. Extend the enhanced Redwood Absence entry page which now supports guided journeys, setting up of default values, and allows to show or hide buttons based on user roles.

items.title: Compensatory Time Interface Enhancements
items.summary: If you use the Entry Level Approval timecard task, compensatory time earned now goes to Absence Management as each time entry is approved, so the balance is usable straight away, not after the whole timecard is approved. Compensatory time also now works for customers using only Projects with a third-party payroll.

items.title: Display Unpaid Break when Absence is Entered on the Timecard
items.summary: Absences entered on the timecard now also show the unpaid break deducted from the absence duration, in a read-only field on the Redwood absence pages (26B did this for absences entered in Absence Management).

items.title: Invalid Dates are Disabled in the Date Picker
items.summary: When you enter absences against past or future assignments using the enhanced Redwood pages, the date picker now allows selection of only the valid dates for the chosen assignment.

items.title: Optional Reason for Discretionary Disbursements
items.summary: You can now set up absence plans so users must pick a reason, from the new ORA_ANC_DISBURSEMENT_REASONS lookup, when they enter or upload discretionary disbursements. Nothing changes until you attach reasons to a plan.

items.title: Prevent Withdrawal of Previously Approved Absences
items.summary: Employees can no longer withdraw an approved absence that they've edited and resubmitted while the change is awaiting approval. The manager has to approve the change first, and withdrawing it after that needs approval too.

items.title: Use VB Studio to Restrict Access to Past and Future Assignments
items.summary: Absence Management enables users to record absences for past assignments that concluded within the last year, as well as, for all active future assignments. You can now further refine these options using two new page properties in the Visual Builder Studio.

items.title: Configure Rules for Benefits Redwood Page Properties
items.summary: Benefits Redwood page properties can now use rules in Visual Builder Studio. Previously, page properties were typically configured as static values, such as enabling or disabling a setting, adding a guided journey, or defining text for the welcome area.

items.title: Display Benefits Document Type Names in Certification Panel Drawers
items.summary: Certification-related pending actions in Redwood Benefits now display document type names based on Benefits configuration. Previously, the document type shown in the panel drawer was derived from the Document of Record (DOR) document types.

items.title: Enhanced Benefits Analyst Agent for Flex Credits and Benefits Representatives
items.summary: The Benefits Analyst Agent now includes additional tools to answer more Benefits-related questions for employees. The agent continues to answer questions only for the logged-in employee.

items.title: Manage Approved Certification Documents in Subsequent Life Events
items.summary: Benefits administrators now have greater flexibility when a certification document has already been approved and a later life event requires additional documentation.

items.title: Preview Certification Attachments in the Benefits Summary
items.summary: You can now preview the supported certification attachments directly in the Redwood Benefits Summary page of Benefits Service Center. PDF and image attachments open in an inline preview.

items.title: Simulate a Life Event for Benefits Administrators
items.summary: Benefits administrators can now simulate a life event for a person from the Benefits Summary page and see the estimated eligibility and rates it would produce. The simulation is read-only and saves nothing.

items.title: Upload Certification Documents Outside the Enrollment Window
items.summary: Employees can now upload required certification documents in Redwood Self-Service Benefits after the enrollment window closes, provided the certification action item is associated with the employee’s latest life event.

items.title: Try the New Redwood Experience
items.summary: More Transportation and Global Trade Management screens are now available in the Redwood UI, along with the Product Map navigation view and Redwood Help and Export. Where both exist the legacy screens remain, but Oracle strongly encourages moving to Redwood.

items.title: Try the New Redwood Experience
items.summary: More Transportation and Global Trade Management screens are now available in the Redwood UI, along with the Product Map navigation view and Redwood Help and Export. Where both exist the legacy screens remain, but Oracle strongly encourages moving to Redwood.

items.title: AI Agent Studio - Seeded Business Objects
items.summary: Thirty ready-made OTM and GTM business objects are now available in AI Agent Studio, so you don't have to map them yourself when building your own AI agents.

items.title: Copy Additional Data from Inventory to Exit Declaration Line
items.summary: When you move goods out of a Free Trade Zone, the exit declaration line can now copy dates (such as the entry date) and zone status from inventory, based on a data configuration you define.

items.title: Enhancement to Restricted Party Screening Workbench
items.summary: In the Restricted Party Screening Workbench, Passed and Failed now show in green and red, and new buttons let you mark a party as Trusted, Requires Screening or Prohibited.

items.title: Enhancements to License Management
items.summary: License management now copes when a shipment exceeds the reserved license amount: a new Allow Supplement from Balance flag lets the assignment draw the extra from the license balance, and a new Adjust License action updates the reserved balance.

items.title: Entry Exit Configuration on Trade Incentive Programs
items.summary: Trade Incentive Programs get a new Entry-Exit Configuration section that replaces the Applicable Profile. It supports both customs and physical inventory tracking and sets the sequence, entry-exit profile and movement type for each program.

items.title: Inline Edit Always Shows External ID (XID)
items.summary: This feature changes the behavior for the Enhanced Workbench Inline Edit so that the External ID (XID) is now always shown. Previously, the option to switch from the Global Identifier (GID) to the External Identifier (XID) was controlled using the Logic Configuration Parameter SHOW XID IN INLINE EDIT.

items.title: Redwood Theme For Enhanced Workbench
items.summary: The Enhanced Workbench picks up Redwood styling: a Redwood strip across the top of layouts and Redwood colors on the side navigation bar.

items.title: Set Trusted or Prohibited Party for Restricted Party Screening
items.summary: This feature allows you to designate a party in your party master as either prohibited or trusted by assigning a new status. This status provides greater control over how parties are handled during screening.

items.title: Transaction Type/Declaration Type Available on Line UIs
items.summary: The transaction type and declaration type are now shown, and searchable, on Trade Transaction Line and Declaration Line pages.

items.title: AI Agent Studio - Seeded Business Objects
items.summary: Thirty ready-made OTM and GTM business objects are now available in AI Agent Studio, so you don't have to map them yourself when building your own AI agents.

items.title: Copy Parameter Override
items.summary: This feature provides you with the option of copying your Parameter Override. The new Copy Parameter Override action can be found by navigating to Logistics Network Modeling > Power Data > Parameter Overrides.

items.title: Inline Edit Always Shows External ID (XID)
items.summary: This feature changes the behavior for the Enhanced Workbench Inline Edit so that the External ID (XID) is now always shown. Previously, the option to switch from the Global Identifier (GID) to the External Identifier (XID) was controlled using the Logic Configuration Parameter SHOW XID IN INLINE EDIT.

items.title: Multi-Day Calendar Overrides
items.summary: The Multi-Day Calendar Override feature allows you to define both a start date and time and an end date and time for your calendar override entries. With the addition of the end date, you can now apply closures or schedule exceptions across a continuous date range without needing to create multiple records.

items.title: Planner Added Documents In Tendering Workflow
items.summary: This feature introduces the ability for you (the planner) to upload and share documents directly within the tendering workflow. Document Actions have been added to the Spot Bid Tender screen, the Online Booking and Tendering (OBT) screen, and the (buy) Shipment to support the use case.

items.title: Rate Shopping - Rate Service Visibility - Change Service Provider
items.summary: This feature provides visibility to the Rate Service in external rate shopping setups where a Rate Offering setup can apply to multiple Rate Service options. In the Change Service Provider action results, you can now clearly see and select the full-service combination, including the rate service.

items.title: Redwood Theme For Enhanced Workbench
items.summary: The Enhanced Workbench picks up Redwood styling: a Redwood strip across the top of layouts and Redwood colors on the side navigation bar.

items.title: Enhance Queries for Wave Research Advisor AI Agent
items.summary: The Wave Research Advisor AI Agent now supports additional wave-related operational inquiries, enabling warehouse personnel to obtain more detailed allocation information through natural language interactions.

items.title: Honor Expiry Date Range Rules for Cross Dock Pick And Allocate
items.summary: Pick and Allocate now validates picked inventory against an Expiry Date Range rule before allocation. A new mobile screen parameter , Expiry Date Range Rule, controls this behaviour.

items.title: Honor Expiry Date Range Rules for Direct Allocation
items.summary: Direct Allocation now supports expiry date validation during allocation. A new screen parameter, Expiry Date Range Rule , lets customers define which expiry date range rule WMS applies when users allocate inventory from a scanned LPN or pallet to an order.

items.title: Honor Expiry Date Range, Order Prioritization Rules for Distribute LPN
items.summary: Distribute LPN can now use Crossdock Flowthrough Rules to decide which received inventory flows straight to which outbound order, based on inventory details, expiry date range, order criteria and priority.

items.title: Improve Receiving Execution with Shipment Progress Visibility in Mobile
items.summary: Warehouse operators and supervisors can now view real-time shipment receiving progress directly within Mobile receiving transactions. The enhancement provides shipment-level visibility into key receiving metrics, allowing users to monitor receiving progress without navigating to other screens or running reports.

items.title: UPS Standard Integration Supports Shipping to Canada
items.summary: The UPS Standard integration now sends an invoice line total (item unit cost times quantity), so shipments to Canada can be manifested. Item unit cost must be above zero, or manifesting may fail.

items.title: View Employee Timeline Metrics
items.summary: A new Employee Timeline Metrics tab in the WFM Employee Dashboard shows each employee's day in one place: facility clock-in and clock-out, work area activity and breaks.

items.title: AI Agent: Negotiation Surrogate Response Assistant
items.summary: Deploy the Surrogate Response Assistant to automate creation of supplier negotiation responses. This new AI Agent template enables category managers to create surrogate responses from supplier response documents received in email.

items.title: Create Transfer Orders with Header Level Descriptive Flexfields
items.summary: Use the Oracle Supply Chain Orchestration Supply Requests REST API and the Supply Order Import FBDI template to create transfer orders with header level descriptive flexfields.

items.title: Create Work Orders with Find Numbers for Substituted Components
items.summary: Supply Chain Orchestration now supports receiving find numbers for substituted components from Oracle Supply Chain Planning and passing them to Oracle Manufacturing during work order creation.

items.title: Redwood: Cancel an Approved Work Confirmation as a Buyer
items.summary: Cancel approved work confirmations as a buyer. Before this update, you couldn't cancel approved work confirmations.

items.title: Redwood: Communicate Purchase Agreements to Multiple Email Recipients
items.summary: Add multiple email recipients when communicating purchase agreements to suppliers. You can now notify internal stakeholders and additional supplier contacts through the same email sent when a new purchase agreement or change order is issued.

items.title: Redwood: Edit Charge Account Segments on Multiple Purchase Order Schedules
items.summary: Select multiple schedules and edit the cost center and natural account segments directly from the Purchase Orders page. You can choose to split partially delivered or billed distributions, and the application will update the segments on the new distribution for the unprocessed remainder.

items.title: Redwood: Review B2B Account Number on Purchasing Documents
items.summary: Review the B2B account number associated with a supplier on purchasing documents using Redwood purchasing pages. Use the supplier information drawer to review the B2B account number when viewing a purchasing document.

items.title: Redwood: Use Extensibility Capabilities to Default Document Styles When Creating Purchasing Documents
items.summary: Use extensibility capabilities to set a default document style when creating purchasing documents using the Redwood experience. You can now define a default document style for the New purchase order and New agreement drawers, as well as for staged documents.

items.title: Redwood: View Additional Information About Location and Supplier
items.summary: View additional information about supplier, ship-to location, bill-to location, and deliver-to location when viewing purchase orders and purchase agreements using a Redwood page.

items.title: Selected External Purchase Prices Bug Fixes in This Update
items.summary: External Purchase Prices FBDI templates now work on Mac as well as Windows. Oracle lists this among the 26C bug fixes that change behavior.

items.title: Selected Purchasing Bug Fixes in This Update
items.summary: Oracle's list of 26C Purchasing fixes that change behavior. The main one: with profile option ORA_PO_CO_BUDGET_DATE_FOR_LIQ set to Y, funds on change orders are now liquidated on the budget date, the change order date or the current date, depending on dates and fulfillment. Others include global DFFs on Approved Supplier List documents and back-arrow navigation on Redwood pages.

items.title: Selected Sourcing Bug Fixes in This Update
items.summary: Fix: in Redwood, a negotiation created from a template now uses the latest version of its negotiation style, so style changes made after the template was created now apply.

items.title: View Additional Information About Preparers, Requesters, Buyers, and Approvers
items.summary: You can now view additional information about the preparers, requesters, buyers, and approvers on requisitions and purchase orders. In addition to details such as name, job title, manager name, and department, you can also view contact information such as email, work phone, and work address.

items.title: Access Cart Details Directly During Requisition Creation
items.summary: You can now access shopping cart details directly while creating a requisition, which improves visibility and makes navigation easier during the request creation process.

items.title: Create Transfer Orders with Header Level Descriptive Flexfields
items.summary: Use the Oracle Supply Chain Orchestration Supply Requests REST API and the Supply Order Import FBDI template to create transfer orders with header level descriptive flexfields.

items.title: Create Work Orders with Find Numbers for Substituted Components
items.summary: Supply Chain Orchestration now supports receiving find numbers for substituted components from Oracle Supply Chain Planning and passing them to Oracle Manufacturing during work order creation.

items.title: Create a Noncatalog Request Without Copying Supplier Details From a Previous Request
items.summary: After you submit a noncatalog or smart form request, the confirmation message now offers Create another request (starting fresh) alongside Create another request with the same supplier. The View cart link moves to the navigation bar at the bottom of the page.

items.title: Identify Attachments and Notes on My Requisitions
items.summary: The note and attachment icons that 26B added to requisition lines now also appear on the My Requisitions page.

items.title: Launch Quote to Purchase Requisition Assistant from Menu
items.summary: The Quote to Purchase Requisition Assistant, which turns emailed supplier quotes into requisitions, can now be started from the Self Service Procurement home page menu, without setting up an email account. You still need to create and publish an instance of the agent in AI Agent Studio.

items.title: Manage Public Shopping Lists
items.summary: Catalog administrators can now manage public shopping lists using a Redwood experience. After opting into this feature, you can access the Redwood Public Shopping Lists page from the quick links under Catalogs.

items.title: Manage Shopping Catalog Category Hierarchies
items.summary: Manage shopping catalog category hierarchies using a Redwood page to create, manage, and reorganize procurement catalog categories for browsing and shopping. You can access the Shopping Catalog Category Hierarchy page from the quick links under Catalogs.

items.title: Search for Deliver-to Locations Using Additional Attributes in Requisitions
items.summary: The enhanced deliver-to location search (by name, code, address, city, postal code or country) now works on the requisition line and summary edit pages, not just in Preferences. It's off by default and switched on with a Visual Builder Studio constant.

items.title: Selected Self Service Procurement Bug Fixes in This Update
items.summary: Fix: charge account combination details are easier to review in requisitions, from the charge account actions menu in edit mode or the account link in read-only mode.

items.title: Sort Shopping Search Results and Shopping Lists by Item Number and Supplier Item
items.summary: Sort shopping search results by item number and supplier item. This feature is also available for shopping lists.

items.title: View Additional Information About Deliver-to Locations
items.summary: You can now view additional information about the deliver-to location on a requisition line, including the address of the location and location code. To use this feature, use the link for the deliver-to location when viewing a requisition line.

items.title: Automatic Creation of Rebills when Canceling Invoices
items.summary: Cancel and rebill project contract invoices with a single action. Rebill invoices contain the same invoice lines and transactions as the original invoice when the cancel and rebill invoice action is initiated without performing any transaction-level adjustments, thereby allowing adjustments as needed on the rebill before resending them to the customer.

items.title: Labor Commitment Reporting in OTBI
items.summary: Leverage Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, or OTBI, to report on labor commitment information for project planning and control. Labor commitment reporting helps you analyze future labor commitments and related cost distributions so you can validate project spend, review commitment liquidation, and manage labor-related project costs more efficiently.

items.title: Milestone Approval History
items.summary: Enable project managers to view a detailed approval history for each milestone, including status changes, initiators, approvers, and timestamps for all approval actions.

items.title: Data Extraction Using Read-Only Replicated Data
items.summary: Extract data with improved reliability and speed, with less impact on core application performance. The simplified extraction experience includes support for full or incremental extracts, on-demand runs or schedules, and status monitoring.

items.title: Optional Ship-To Account and Site Through Configurable Contract Line Validations
items.summary: Two new contract line validations let privileged users make the ship-to account and ship-to site optional on project contract lines, by changing them to Warning or turning them off. By default they're still required.

items.title: Program Performance Advisor
items.summary: Drive program success with AI-enabled program analysis and actionable plans. Oracle AI helps uncover program-specific trends and generates actionable recommendations, empowering data-driven decision-making and optimizing program execution.

items.title: Program Progress Summary Generator
items.summary: Reduce time spent on report writing with AI-powered summaries for project programs. Generative AI automatically drafts summaries highlighting key achievements, insights, and recommendations.

items.title: Project Billing and Revenue Event Creation Assistant
items.summary: Helps users create recurring invoice and revenue events for eligible external fixed-price contracts through a guided conversational experience. The assistant validates the contract or contract line, billing frequency, event type, contract line dates, contract line amount, and existing event details.

items.title: Project Capitalization Analyst
items.summary: Investigate project capitalization issues through a guided, conversational experience. Project accountants can review pending capitalization costs for a project, narrow large result sets by business dimensions such as transaction source, task, or expenditure type, and diagnose why selected project cost transactions didn’t generate asset lines.

items.title: Project Change Order Initiation Assistant
items.summary: Leverage generative AI to create a change order from a project issue. For issues that need a change order, using the information available in the issue, the project manager can now create a change order effortlessly.

items.title: Project Change Summary Generation Assistant
items.summary: Create a comprehensive summary of a project change order with a single click. The summary highlighting the impact of the change order on the project financials helps align stakeholders with project updates and eases approvals.

items.title: Project Contract Bill Transactions Assistant
items.summary: An AI assistant that finds, reviews and summarizes project bill transactions by project, contract, status or date range. Users need the assistant's role in AI Agent Studio.

items.title: Project Contract Invoicing Assistant
items.summary: The Project Contract Invoicing Assistant enables you to search and review invoices by business unit, customer, contract number, and status. It also allows you to process invoices to Released status after review and create cancel credit invoices for original standard invoices.

items.title: Project Contract Validation Assistant
items.summary: Validate project contracts by checking delivered and custom validation rules, providing resolution details, and enabling corrective action using the Project Contract Validation Assistant .

items.title: Project Contract and Customer Purchase Order Reconciliation Assistant
items.summary: Reconcile project contracts with attached customer purchase order documents by comparing key attributes and identifying mismatches so corrective action can be taken.

items.title: Project Contract and Sales Order Reconciliation Assistant
items.summary: Reconcile project contracts with attached sales orders by comparing key attributes and identifying mismatches so corrective action can be taken. This automated reconciliation helps reduce contract approval cycles, accelerate funding, and achieve faster invoicing and revenue recognition.

items.title: Project Cost Adjustment Assistant
items.summary: Perform project cost transfer adjustments for individual transactions using natural language prompts. Transfer costs across projects, tasks, awards, and funding sources, and adjust attributes such as cost type and project role.

items.title: Project Cost Exceptions Assistant
items.summary: Identify and analyze unprocessed project cost exceptions using natural language requests. The assistant streamlines exception investigation and resolution by summarizing and categorizing exceptions and proposing resolution options for each type of exception.

items.title: Project Financial Control Agents
items.summary: Gain clear insight into project costs, capitalization, and billing to improve financial oversight and keep projects aligned with business objectives. With the Project Financial Control Agents, project teams can quickly understand cost distribution flows and monitor financial progress through guided, conversational interactions.

items.title: Project Performance Agents
items.summary: Improve project oversight with timely performance insights and guided analysis throughout the project lifecycle. Project Performance Agents analyze project performance data in the background and surface proactive insights when defined conditions are met.

items.title: Project Planning Agents
