items.summary: Accelerate project delivery by transforming business inputs into execution-ready project plans, adapting to change faster, and enabling more informed planning decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

items.title: Project Planning Workspace for Project Initiation and Budget Planning
items.summary: Accelerate project delivery with faster project initiation and governed budget planning using the Project Planning Workspace. Initiate projects from Statements of Work, Requests for Proposal, sales opportunities, or natural-language prompts.

items.title: Project Proposal Generation Assistant
items.summary: Create a comprehensive project proposal that covers project objectives, scope, timeline, budget estimates, and staffing plans, using Oracle AI during project planning.

items.title: Clock In and Clock Out of Work Order Operations in My Maintenance Work
items.summary: In organizations using advanced scheduling, maintenance technicians can now clock in and out of work order operations in My Maintenance Work. The first clock-in starts the operation automatically, and it's marked complete once every assigned technician has finished.

items.title: Redwood: Create and Manage Follow Up Work Orders in My Maintenance Work
items.summary: Maintenance technicians can now create and manage follow-up work orders directly from a source work order to track additional maintenance issues discovered during or after execution.

items.title: Redwood: Edit Work Orders from My Maintenance Work
items.summary: Maintenance technicians can now edit work order details directly from My Maintenance Work , Preview Work , and Report Work pages. This enhancement provides in-context access to the Edit Work Order page, so technicians can make updates without leaving their current workflow.

items.title: Redwood: Use a Separate Operation to Track Rework in a Standard or Nonstandard Discrete Manufacturing Work Order
items.summary: Discrete manufacturing work orders can now include a separate rework operation. Supervisors move rejected quantities to it and track rework progress and costs in the same work order, without completing into inventory and opening a new work order. Redwood pages only.

items.title: Use Kanban Planning to Manage Just-in-Time Material Replenishment
items.summary: New Kanban plans calculate the right number of Kanban cards or bin size for each pull sequence from an external forecast and pull sequence attributes (average daily demand, lead time, safety stock), and can then update the pull sequences.

items.title: AI Agent: Order Exception Assistant Enhancements
items.summary: You can now resolve selected fulfillment, functional, and technical order exceptions directly from the Oracle Exception Assistant. You can also review affected orders and lines, understand why processing stopped, and take guided actions such as processing pending fulfillment responses, canceling eligible tasks, recovering orders, checking availability, or continuing orchestration.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Order Promising Demands from External Source Systems
items.summary: You can use the Redwood user experience to manage order promising for sales order lines collected from an order management system. Use search criteria to filter and select order lines, then prioritize and schedule them in required sequence.

items.title: Manage Organizations for Global Work Definitions Using File-Based Data Import
items.summary: Work definitions are defined at the maintenance organization level based on organization-specific work areas, work centers, material items, and resources. In this update, if you have work definitions with the same scope across multiple maintenance organizations, you can manage them globally.

items.title: AI Agentic App: Inventory Planning Command Center
items.summary: You can now use the AI agentic application named Inventory Planning Command Center to quickly analyze replenishment plan stockouts and receive actionable recommendations to resolve them.

items.title: Create Transfer Orders with Header Level Descriptive Flexfields
items.summary: Use the Oracle Supply Chain Orchestration Supply Requests REST API and the Supply Order Import FBDI template to create transfer orders with header level descriptive flexfields.

items.title: Create Work Orders with Find Numbers for Substituted Components
items.summary: Supply Chain Orchestration now supports receiving find numbers for substituted components from Oracle Supply Chain Planning and passing them to Oracle Manufacturing during work order creation.

items.title: Redwood: Calculate Planning Percentages for Product Families
items.summary: Demand Management can now forecast at product-family level: it calculates planning percentages from history and splits family forecasts down to items, and Supply Planning can consume the forecast at item or family level. You switch it on per plan.

items.title: Redwood: Compare a Plan to its Archived Versions Using a New User Experience
items.summary: You can now use the Redwood interface to compare a plan to its archived versions. You can select a total of three plans and archived versions.

items.title: Redwood: Compare a Plan to its Archived Versions Using a New User Experience
items.summary: You can now use the Redwood interface to compare a plan to its archived versions. You can select a total of three plans and archived versions.

items.title: Redwood: Create Link to AI Agents Using a New User Experience
items.summary: You can use the Redwood user experience to add, edit, and manage AI Agents as links tied to specific visualization, such as a table or a graph. The links can be reused across plans that include the visualization and can be edited or deleted by the link owner.

items.title: Redwood: Create Link to AI Agents Using a New User Experience
items.summary: You can use the Redwood user experience to add, edit, and manage AI Agents as links tied to specific visualization, such as a table or a graph. The links can be reused across plans that include the visualization and can be edited or deleted by the link owner.

items.title: Redwood: Deep Links to Planning Pages and Visualizations with Context
items.summary: You can now navigate between planning pages using deep links that preserve context such as plan, page, page group, visualization, and filter details. It improves analysis efficiency by directly accessing relevant pages or visualizations with up to five filter context values applied.

items.title: Redwood: Enable Wildcard Search
items.summary: You can now use the asterisk (*) wildcard in searches to accelerate discovery of content across key areas: pages, page groups, visualizations (including the content library), and measures in Edit Properties and Build Plan.

items.title: Redwood: Enable Wildcard Search
items.summary: You can now use the asterisk (*) wildcard in searches to accelerate discovery of content across key areas: pages, page groups, visualizations (including the content library), and measures in Edit Properties and Build Plan.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Analysis Sets Using a New User Experience
items.summary: You can now create, edit, delete, and apply analysis sets from the Visualizations and Analysis Sets page in Redwood. Analysis sets let you save commonly used measures and members and apply them to tables and graphs or use them as focused data views without creating filters.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Analysis Sets Using a New User Experience
items.summary: You can now create, edit, delete, and apply analysis sets from the Visualizations and Analysis Sets page in Redwood. Analysis sets let you save commonly used measures and members and apply them to tables and graphs or use them as focused data views without creating filters.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Stacked Visualizations Using a New User Experience
items.summary: Stacked Visualizations lets you assemble multiple analytic layers, such as line, stacked bar, area, scatter, waterfall graphs, and pivot-table snapshots, into one composite view.

items.title: Redwood: Manage Stacked Visualizations Using a New User Experience
items.summary: Stacked Visualizations lets you assemble multiple analytic layers, such as line, stacked bar, area, scatter, waterfall graphs, and pivot-table snapshots, into one composite view.

items.title: Redwood: Set Up Waterfall and Trend Analyses and Plan Comparisons Using a New User Experience
items.summary: Waterfall analyses, trend analyses and plan comparisons, previously set up in the classic interface, can now be configured on the Comparison tab of Redwood planning tables and graphs.

items.title: Redwood: Set Up Waterfall and Trend Analyses and Plan Comparisons Using a New User Experience
items.summary: Waterfall analyses, trend analyses and plan comparisons, previously set up in the classic interface, can now be configured on the Comparison tab of Redwood planning tables and graphs.
